title: The pack carries a Rust column and krn adopt --init --stack rust is born green
body:
Why: Fable 1115f slice 7; detectStack knows Rust but the pack has zero Rust records.
Outcome: at least 6 enforced Rust records (committed Cargo.lock, fmt check, clippy deny-warnings, no library unwrap, pinned toolchain, tests present) and an init rust stack, in one PR including plants.
Files: standards/records.json, src/adopt/init.ts, scripts/standards-audit.ts, test/scripts/planted-records.test.ts.
Proof: fixtures, init rust 0 FAIL, planted N/N bite, one public Rust clone with zero false-red.
Serial: after the harvest slice; changes the enforced set and planted matrix.
